title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW As a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) at Lenskart, you will be the face of the store the first person a customer meets and the last impression they carry. You will own the end-to-end in-store experience, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed, heard, and valued. Beyond warm hospitality, you will play a critical role in resolving escalations, managing difficult situations with grace, and turning dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Customer Greeting & Experience Management Welcome every customer entering the store with warmth and professionalism, setting a positive first impression from the door. Understand customer needs proactively and guide them to the right product, service, or associate within the store. Acknowledge and manage wait times; keep customers engaged and comfortable during peak hours. Coordinate seamless handoffs between optometrists, sales associates, and the CRM desk. Grievance Resolution & Customer Recovery Own all in-store customer complaints from product defects and service delays to prescription concerns. Resolve grievances at the store level within defined TATs; escalate with full context when required. Maintain a complaint log and follow up post-resolution to confirm customer satisfaction. Identify recurring complaint patterns and flag them to store leadership and the operations team. Difficult Customer Handling Manage irate or highly dissatisfied customers with empathy, patience, and solution orientation. De-escalate tense situations through active listening and calm, composed communication. Exercise judgment on goodwill gestures (replacement, priority service, escalation) within authorized limits. Store Experience & CRM Operations Maintain store ambience, queue management, and signage in the customer-facing zone. Capture customer feedback (NPS, in-store forms) and share weekly insights with the store team. Track daily footfall, walk-in-to-conversion ratios, and complaint resolution metrics. Coordinate with the post-sales and fulfilment team for order status updates and delivery queries. 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Must-Have 1–4 years of experience in customer-facing roles — hospitality (hotel front desk, concierge), premium retail, airport lounge, or mall guest services. Demonstrated ability to handle difficult, unhappy, or demanding customers with composure and empathy. Fluency in Kannada and English; Hindi is a strong advantage. Warm, approachable personality with a solution-first and ownership mindset. Graduate in any discipline. 
 Good to Have Background from premium malls (UB City, Phoenix, Palladium), 5-star hotel front desks (Taj, Oberoi, Leela), or airport lounges (Encalm, Plaza Premium). Familiarity with CRM tools, complaint ticketing systems, or basic store management software. Prior exposure to eyewear, healthcare retail, or regulated product categories. Comfort with basic data entry — logging complaints, updating resolution status, sharing daily reports. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Customer Empathy Acknowledges emotions before jumping to solutions; makes every customer feel heard and respected. Conflict De-escalation Stays calm under pressure; reframes complaints into resolvable problems without getting defensive. Service Ownership Does not pass the buck; sees every complaint through to closure personally. Communication Clear, polite, and confident in both Kannada and English; adapts tone to the customer. Attention to Detail Notices potential service gaps proactively and addresses them before they escalate. Adaptability Maintains service quality consistently across high-footfall peak hours and quieter periods.

Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**What will you do:**


The CCaaS Platinum Support Account Manager is the main technical support contact serving Sprinklr’s largest and most complex customers. We work with program managers and executive level decision makers at large enterprise brands to deliver excellent customer support experience. Platinum Support also acts as an internal escalation point, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success \& Services to resolve issues. The PSAM also acts as the day\-to\-day internal escalation point, and point of contact for clients, ensuring optimal client service as it relates to platform performance, functionality, enhancements, and configuration while supporting line management and operational excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute important events for customers in collaboration with success/MS team

* Share regular insights into new product features with customer
* Discuss and plan release readiness with customer to meet customer expectations and ensure faster resolution on release related issues.
* Closely monitor TTR for all support cases from your accounts and always ensure adherence to SLA.
* Roll up your sleeve and work with support/engineering teams to debug critical issues reported by your accounts.
* Ensure the highest standard of service delivery to our platinum customers.
* Expertise in business analysis, functional specification, system design, platform configuration, testing, and training while assisting in operational housekeeping. This includes:
* Provide social insights and recommendations to support clients’ business practices
* Design and configure the appropriate Sprinklr solution to meet all requirements based on best practices and client’s custom needs, adhering to primary business use cases and platform functionalities
* Perform health checks of existing customers in need of platform upgrades and suggest solutions based on best practices and client needs.
* Provide consulting advise to clients about Sprinklr platform during different phases of project implementation

Lead new product rollouts, support new restaurant openings and drive strong sales across new and existing locations. 
 4) KEEP EVERYONE MOVING TOGETHER

Communicate goals, results and next steps clearly so every team understands what they are working towards and how they contribute. Keep growing everyday. Ask for feedback, share ideas and keep finding better ways to work.
